messages:
incident-bot: :warning: realtime alert: /v1/generate p95 > 500ms (SLO 300ms), p99 > 1.5s. Rule: realtime_latency_p95_p99. panels: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/realtime

alice huang: saw it. oncall team notified. is this isolated to any region?

benji roberts: I'm oncall. Seeing spikes in us-east and eu-west, ap-south looks noisy but lower magnitude. Taking triage lead.

carmen: Any recent deployments or routing changes in the last 10m?

devon: A streaming optimization canary was promoted ~7m ago (commit d4c2f1). Logs show increased 'stall' markers from that time.

maya: We did a cache rebalancer tweak yesterday but that was low risk and fully rolled. Not related timing-wise.

raj: Quick query: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95), percentile(latency_ms,99) FROM requests WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND env='prod' GROUP BY time(1m)` -> sharp p95 climb at 2032100020, aligns with canary.

alice huang: immediate actions: 1) stop canary/rollback 2) divert streaming to fallback variant (quant-8) 3) scale streaming workers 4) inspect KV cache metrics. Who will run the rollback?

benji roberts: rolling back canary now: `deployctl rollback streaming-optimizer --to stable`.

deply-bot: rollback started (task dl-59102). estimate 90s.

carmen: I'll split traffic: `routerctl split --route /v1/stream --variant quant-8 --percent 35` to move load away from canary.

devon: K8s scale applied: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment streaming-workers --replicas=64` to give extra capacity.

maya: cache metrics: prefix_hit_rate dropped from 94% -> 50% after deploy. suspect invalidation logic in optimizer.

raj: tail logs:
```
2026-06-18T09:15:10Z stream id=nx-12 stall_ms=1400 backend=shard-7
2026-06-18T09:15:15Z request id=rt-88 latency_ms=2100 model=streaming-optimizer canary=true kv_miss=true
```

benji roberts: rollback finished. dl-59102 completed. Canary removed. Confirming router split and scale.

alice huang: grafana shows p95 dropping, p99 still elevated. panels: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/realtime?orgId=1&panel=streaming

devon: pods coming up, 62/64 ready.

carmen: split effective. fallback variant p99 ~1.05s, better than canary.

support-bot: customer impact: telemetry flags 6 enterprise tenants with degraded sessions, ~900 affected sessions in past 15m. CS notified, outbound message queued.

maya: investigating cache layer. Reproduced locally: optimizer path strips prefix normalization causing cache key mismatch -> mass misses.

raj: distributed trace for a slow request:
```
ingress -> route -> cache_lookup (miss) -> model_warmup -> compute_attention -> response
cache_lookup: key mismatch due to new normalizer
```

alice huang: mitigation summary: rollback done, fallback routing in place, scaled pods, support notified. Need a temporary guard in cache to avoid key invalidation. Who can patch quickly?

benji roberts: I can take an operational patch to treat unmatched keys as 'stale_ok' to avoid mass invalidation. Will coordinate with devon for rollout.

devon: will prepare patch. small change: `if (!prefix_format_ok) return stale_ok;` plus a feature flag. Aim to ship in ~10-15m.

carmen: please include unit test and enable behind flag. Don't make permanent default.

incident-bot: escalation threshold reached. PD-SRE paging if regression returns within 20m.

benji roberts: patch pushed to edge-canary (edge-guard-2). Enabling flag to 40% to validate.

maya: after enabling, cache hit rate up to 86%, p99 fell to ~850ms. Good signal.

support-bot: outbound customer update sent: "We detected elevated latency on streaming; we've rolled back a canary, applied fallbacks, and are monitoring. A detailed RCA will follow." :email:

alice huung: (note: name typo) capturing next steps: INC-3897 created for RCA and follow-up. Owners: benji (ops), maya & devon (fix), carmen (rollout doc).

benji roberts: I'll stay on until stable for 1hr.

devon: checking infra metrics: redis shard-7 CPU peaked at 82% but not saturated. KV churn explains latency, not infra failure.

raj: final check at 2032100300: p95=210ms, p99=800ms, error rates back to baseline. Marking mitigated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2032100300. Follow-up: RCA + tighter canary gating on cache-affecting changes (INC-3897).

alice huang: thanks all, great response. I'll draft the RCA and link follow-ups. :thumbsup:
